youtube_spacing_rule: YouTube (via Buffer) allows 2 posts per ROLLING 24 h, and Buffer sends a few minutes late. Each YouTube post must be more than 24 h after the YouTube post two before it. Using only the 9 AM / 12 PM slots that gives the pattern 9+12, 12, 9, 9+12, 12, 9 ... (4 posts per 3 days). Example from 2026-11-27: 27th 9+12, 28th 12, 29th 9, 30th 9+12, Dec 1 12, Dec 2 9.
